model: Nomad Mk3 26 Rohloff equipped bike straight bar
description: Details A new Thorn Nomad Mk3 with Rohloff - Blue - 61L - Straight Bar bike. This bike would suit a rider of 1778mm (5ft 10 in) to 2006 mm (6ft 7in).Virtual top tube 635mm.Standover hight at mid tube 850mm. This bike would be ideal for expedition rides , distance touring, commuting or weekly shop or would happily be your lifetime mode of transport. If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk.
